rejection_reasons: The residual model did not clear the predeclared one-percent proper-score point and upper-confidence-bound gates for every required comparator and component.
Hits over 0.5 was worse than the fitted empirical-Bayes comparator by 0.2786 percent Brier and 0.2377 percent log loss.
HR over 0.5 beat the league-rate point estimate but did not clear the Brier uncertainty bound, and it was not calibration-noninferior to the empirical-Bayes comparator.
Per-PA Total Bases was worse than league, empirical Bayes, and the frozen all-prior CatBoost core on both proper scores.
The HR top-decile support gate passed, but the candidate was worse than the empirical-Bayes and frozen-core comparators in tail calibration and proper scores.
measured_limiter: The strict-prior player empirical-Bayes history carries useful signal; the available marginal process summaries add discrimination in places but degrade proper scores and calibration. The missing input is richer truthful contact-quality structure, not a hand-tuned coefficient.
single_highest_value_next_action: Build and validate one strictly-prior batter contact-quality input block from permissible raw Statcast: joint exit-velocity and launch-angle categories, official sweet-spot/hard-hit/barrel counts, batted-ball-type counts, EV50-style robust tail summaries, and source-supported spray/pull counts, all with denominators and missingness. Do not fit another candidate until this source layer passes its timing and mutation contracts.
